# 🎲 Lucky Draw Game

An interactive lottery draw web application with three mystery boxes, each containing different types of questions. Perfect for team building activities, icebreakers, and fun group interactions!

## 🌐 Online Demo

**[▶️ Click here to play online!](https://htmlpreview.github.io/?https://github.com/hongjiapeng/lottery-draw/blob/master/lottery.html)**

No installation required - just open and start drawing!

## ✨ Features

- **Three Question Categories:**
  - 🎯 **Daily Choices**: Two-choice preference questions
  - ✨ **Amazing Hypotheticals**: Creative and imaginative scenarios
  - 🌟 **Team & Personality**: Self-reflection and team dynamics

- **Interactive UI:**
  - Beautiful gradient backgrounds
  - Smooth animations and transitions
  - 3D hover effects
  - Modal popups for question display

- **Smart Question Management:**
  - No question repeats until all have been drawn
  - Continue drawing from the same box with "Next" button
  - Automatic question pool reset

- **Configurable:**
  - Easy to modify questions in the code
  - All questions stored in a simple JavaScript array

## 🚀 Usage

**Option 1: Play Online**
- Simply click the online demo link above - no download needed!

**Option 2: Download and Use Locally**
1. Download `lottery.html` from this repository
2. Open it in any modern web browser
3. Click on any of the three boxes to draw a question
4. Use the "Next" button to continue drawing from the same box
5. Use the "Close" button to return to the main screen

## 🎨 Responsive Design

Works seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

## 📝 Customization

To add or modify questions, edit the `boxes` array in the JavaScript section:

```javascript
const boxes = [
    {
        icon: '🎯',
        title: 'Daily Choices',
        questions: [
            // Add your questions here
        ]
    },
    // ... more boxes
];
```

## 🌐 Live Demo

Simply download and open `lottery.html` in your browser - no server or installation required!
